subject: Renewal initiation + QBR date options — BlueFrame capacity uplift
body:
---- Message 1 ----
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@blueframe.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal initiation + QBR date options — BlueFrame capacity uplift

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our discussion, I wanted to start the formal renewal orchestration for BlueFrame Systems (DF-7842) and align on a short timeline for the capacity uplift + term adjustment you requested. Proposed next steps: 

- Confirm target renewal date (current term ends 2028-10-01)
- Lock QBR slot to review usage, headroom and the proposed burst plan
- Share mutual action plan and procurement/PO timeline so we can queue Dedicated capacity

QBR date options (all PST):
- Tue 2028-08-29 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2028-08-30 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2028-09-06 09:00–10:00

Samir, can you confirm which of these works and whether procurement needs any particular documentation up-front (SOW, SOC2 evidence, PO template, etc.)? I attached a draft mutual action plan and a preliminary QBR agenda.

Thanks —
Sofia Ivanova
Account Lead, Renewals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BlueFrame_MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx (spreadsheet, 130KB), QBR_agenda_v1.pdf (PDF, 95KB)

---- Message 2 ----
From: Samir Khan <samir@blueframe.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueframe.com>, procurement@blueframe.com
Date: Mon, 20 Aug 2028 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal initiation + QBR date options — BlueFrame capacity uplift

Hi Sofia —

Appreciate the clear plan. Quick answers:
- We need the renewal completed by 2028-09-15 to align with our fiscal close.
- Of your proposed slots, Aug 30 at 14:00 PST looks best for the QBR.
- Procurement asked for: finalized pricing table, Master Services Agreement redline window (we may have 2 weeks), and a short security checklist (SOC2 + data residency note).

Also: can your team include a short demo of any efficiency gains (batching/kv-cache improvements) that might affect our unit cost assumptions? Elena will join to coordinate product and procurement.

Thanks —
Samir Khan
Director, Cloud Ops
BlueFrame Systems

---- Message 3 ----
From: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khan <samir@blueframe.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, naomi.feldman@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal initiation + QBR date options — BlueFrame capacity uplift

Samir / Sofia —

Thanks — confirmed for Aug 30 14:00 PST. Jordan from Renewals (legal/contract coordination) here. A few operational notes in advance to keep the procurement path clean: 

- I'll circulate a clean MSA + a single-page pricing summary by EOD Wed (2028-08-22). If BlueFrame anticipates any contractual escalations, flag them now so we can triage.
- We can accept a PO; our finance team needs the billing contact and the PO number at signature.
- For the 2-week MSA review window: please note that expedited routing may be possible if the legal redlines are limited to payment terms.

Attachment: provisional_pricing_table.xlsx (I'll upload to the HubSpot deal after this thread).

Jordan Blake
Senior Renewals Manager
Redwood Inference

---- Message 4 ----
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueframe.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Samir Khan <samir@blueframe.com>, procurement@blueframe.com
Date: Tue, 21 Aug 2028 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal initiation + QBR date options — BlueFrame capacity uplift

Hi all —

Aug 30 14:00 PST works for us. Procurement: please see our internal PO process (attached as PO_flow_v2.pdf) — we typically need 7 business days once we receive the signed MSA and pricing.

On the demo: yes, please include a 10–15 minute segment on the latest batching/quantization profiles that could materially reduce per-token costs. Our finance lead will be on the QBR and will want a clear delta in expected run-rate.

One ask: can Redwood provide a short note on data segregation and KMS integration for our compliance team before the QBR? That will help speed sign-off.

Thanks —
Elena Torres
Head of Platform Engineering
BlueFrame Systems

---- Message 5 ----
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Samir Khan <samir@blueframe.com>, Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueframe.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Aug 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal initiation + QBR date options — BlueFrame capacity uplift

All —

I'll own the QBR logistics and the pre-read packet. Action items I have captured: 
- Jordan: finalize and attach clean MSA + pricing table (target EOD 2028-08-22)
- Sofia: update mutual action plan with procurement milestones and send to procurement@blueframe.com
- Karthik: prepare a 10–15 minute demo snippet on batching/kv-cache improvements + a 1-page cost-delta note
- BlueFrame: confirm PO timeline and billing contact (Elena / procurement)

I'll assemble the pre-read (QBR_agenda_v1.pdf + pricing + security note) and share 48 hours before the meeting. Confirmed meeting: 2028-08-30 14:00–15:00 PST.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Renewals Operations
Redwood Inference

> On Tue, 21 Aug 2028 at 11:02, Elena Torres <elena.torres@blueframe.com> wrote:
> > Hi all —
> >
> > Aug 30 14:00 PST works for us. Procurement: please see our internal PO process (attached as PO_flow_v2.pdf) — we typically need 7 business days once we receive the signed MSA and pricing.
